program.name: Catch-Up Full Body
program.subject: Busy week
program.blurb: One longer full-body session for the day you finally get, supersets then a circuit.
program.about: For the week when one session is all you get, so it covers everything. Strength supersets come first, a lower and an upper lift back to back, then a circuit of four more moves. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
